==Trivia==
*In all servers but EN, ''Through a Path of Briars'' is named '''Chop the Thorns, Open Circuit'''. The name was changed in EN so it would represent the intended meaning much clearer, which is a reference to [[wikipedia:Karl Llewellyn|Karl Llewellyn]]'s ''The Bramble Bush'' wherein it is stated that the study of jurisprudence was like a path of thorns.
*"Adumbration" in ''As In My Adumbration'' means "a vague indication of what is to come" (i.e. foreshadowing).
*''Arbiter Aequissimus'' is Latin for "The Most Just Arbitrator".
